id: title:TueHaulund:refuse backfills when ai analysis is off

review.posthog_relevance: Replay Vision backfill workflow enforcement for AI consent, blocking ingestion for teams without approval.
review.reason: Adds AI consent checks and a private helper method to the Replay Vision backfill workflow, preventing execution without approval. P1.F1.H1 imports the consent check and constant; P1.F1.H2 adds the private check and raises a 400 error; P1.F1.H3 invokes the check before processing. This is a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual implementation of the helper function and constant is absent, and the tier is assigned based on the observed enforcement and checks rather than the full implementation. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the helper function `is_ai_data_processing_approved` or the constant `AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED_CODE` referenced in P1.F1.H1, nor does it include the definition of the `_require_ai_consent` method's dependency. While P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H3 show the call and P1.F2.H1 shows the test, the actual source of the check and the constant are absent

observations.behavior: Adds import for AI consent check and required code constant.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if an organization has approved AI data processing before allowing Replay Vision backfills.

observations.behavior: Adds a new private method to check AI consent and raise a validation error if not approved.
observations.posthog_connection: Blocks the creation and resumption of Replay Vision backfills for teams without AI consent, returning a 400 error.

observations.behavior: Calls the new AI consent check immediately after fetching the scanner and before processing the request.
observations.posthog_connection: Enforces the AI consent check during the creation of a backfill, preventing the workflow from proceeding without approval.
